correctness.rationale: Selfinverse partial bijection requires common image/domain S, and is an order automorphism of the induced fence F_n[S] squaring to identity. Connected components are maximal selected runs; a long odd run has C2 reversal automorphism, while singleton/even runs have trivial automorphism; odd run min/max types differ. For m copies of a type, the involutive wreath-product action has j swapped pairs with coefficient m!g^j/(2^j j!(m−2j)!) and correct U,V weights. Product over types and sum over all S is exhaustive. Deleting a vertex gives the n−1 rank formulas and nonadjacent pairs supply rank2=(n−1)². Independent direct involutive-permutation enumeration for every subset n=1..9 exactly matched all joint fixed/two-cycle coefficients and totals n7/8/9 =246,561,1312; all-n conclusion is structural, not finite extrapolation.
residual_risks: Finite tests alone are not a universal proof.
